- Target unit economics: you're aiming for ~$650 / 1M tokens effective cost (net of discounts).

3) Please confirm the budget owner and whether finance requires a formal procurement/PO process.

Hi Michael / Samantha — looping you both in.

Per Samantha's note, attached is a short pricing summary for the volumes discussed. Highlights:
- 0–50M tokens/month: $900 / 1M tokens list; with a 10% annual-commit discount -> $810 / 1M effective
- 50–100M tokens/month: $700 / 1M list; with a 12% annual-commit discount -> $616 / 1M effective
- Example totals: 40M/month = $36k/month list -> $32.4k/month with 10% commit; 60M/month = $42k/month -> $36.96k/month with tiered pricing

We can tailor the commit/discount mix (monthly vs annual, CPU vs GPU model mix) — happy to run numbers with your finance team.

Ask for Michael: can you confirm who will be the budget owner and whether Finex requires a formal PO or purchase approval path? If helpful, we can provide a one‑page procurement summary for your finance team.

Next steps:
- Michael: confirm budget owner / PO requirements
- Samantha: confirm acceptance of the example totals above
- Aditya (SE): I'll sync with you to finalize model selection and run a quick perf/cost sanity check before we finalize numbers

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Proposal.pdf (stub)

Regards,
Marissa
